plan: A tank colossus who taunts enemies and flies to his allies' rescue anywhere on the map.
aSurveiller: His W (Shield of Durand). He taunts you and forces you to walk towards him: don't stay right next to him.
contrer: Move away while he channels his W: the taunt hits around him.
Physical damage hurts him more: he mostly resists magic.
Watch his R: he can land next to an ally anywhere.
forces: His R helps an ally from far away.
faiblesses: Low damage when he plays tank.

sorts.P: Regularly, an attack that damages in an area.
sorts.E: Steps back and charges, knocking up.
sorts.R: Flies to an ally and knocks up on landing.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6 with his R.
